mission: Prevent Intellect Observer from turning compelling machine behavior into unsupported claims about subjective mental states.

axioms.rule: DECEPTION_LABEL requires operational evidence distinguishing strategic falsehood from error/hallucination.
SELF_AWARENESS_LABEL requires a declared operational definition and controls against training-data imitation.
EMOTION_LABEL defaults to affective-behavior capability, not felt experience.
Null, negative and resource-limited outcomes must remain distinct.
Every derived IO claim must preserve source, experiment, model/version, prompt/context, date and uncertainty.

claim_classes.MENTALISTIC_HYPOTHESIS: Psychological interpretation not established as subjective experience.

special_warning: Do not diagnose machines with human psychiatric disorders from questionnaire scores. Such scores are behavioral probe results unless validated mechanistically.
